name_zh: 好用服务间首班开门闸盒
name_en: Works Bay First Authorized Shift Gate Wallet
purpose_zh: 把首班开放前必须取得的授权、复核和失效条件装进一个现场纸质闸盒。没有对应回执，相关服务保持关闭；数字界面不能自行放行。
purpose_en: Put every authorization, counter-check, and expiry condition required before the first public shift into one physical gate wallet. Without the corresponding receipt, the affected service stays closed; the digital interface cannot release itself.

physical_form.container: one orange A5 gate wallet kept at the public counter
physical_form.contents: seven gate receipts, one public state strip, one close-and-carry sheet
physical_form.release_method: the duty lead sets the public state only after checking that each required paper receipt carries both functional signatures and is still valid
physical_form.digital_boundary: the AI or interface may display the signed state but cannot create, sign, waive, or extend a gate receipt

two_key_rule.first_key: the accountable functional owner signs for the underlying fact or resource
two_key_rule.second_key: a different functional role replays or counter-checks the evidence
two_key_rule.conflict_rule: one person may not sign both keys for the same gate
two_key_rule.missing_key_action: keep the affected service closed and show the current manual or closed state

receipt_must_show: authorized room or bounded trial area
public opening and hard closing time
access, restoration, and hand-back conditions
gates.expires_when: the authorized shift closes or the site condition changes

receipt_must_show: ordinary, no-app, accessible, and emergency paths walked
clear route and temporary equipment positions
stop and evacuation actions physically reachable
gates.expires_when: a route, barrier, counter, crowd condition, or emergency provision changes
gates.if_missing_keep_closed: the affected room, route, and assisted service

receipt_must_show: one complete task finished without an app
dated public source and expiry printed on the result
issue id and human contact handed to the replayer
gates.expires_when: the form, source, task steps, contact, or language version changes
gates.if_missing_keep_closed: AI assistance; the service may open only as a verified manual route

receipt_must_show: dated source list and critical bilingual facts
minimum fields, retention limit, and deletion action
dependency disconnect, public-record export, and interface removal path
gates.expires_when: a source, purpose, data field, retention rule, model, or supplier changes
gates.if_missing_keep_closed: AI assistance and any affected data collection

receipt_must_show: named duty lead and present takeover staff
break, substitution, and uncovered-shift rule
paper task and physical stop demonstrated by the substitute
gates.expires_when: the shift closes or a named person leaves without an accepted substitute
gates.if_missing_keep_closed: all assisted service; manual service also closes if no qualified person accepts it

receipt_must_show: three comparable quotations or the recorded public-framework exception
quantity, acceptance action, recurring cost, removal, and restoration
named buyer, budget authority, and purchase route
gates.expires_when: scope, quantity, quote validity, funding authority, or acceptance owner changes
gates.if_missing_keep_closed: ordering, supplier commitment, and any cost claim

receipt_must_show: opening state and every live gate receipt
one announced fault card with no unsuspecting visitor
closing reconciliation, deletion result, hand-back, and next-state decision
gates.expires_when: the shift closes; nothing carries forward without a new dated release

print_and_use_order: print the seven blank receipts and the four-state public strip
write one site-and-shift id across every receipt
collect G01 through G06 before any public opening
let the duty lead and independent replayer set G07 and the visible state
put failed or expired receipts in the issue sleeve; never overwrite them
at close, reconcile every receipt and issue; print a new set for the next shift
originality_boundary: This gate wallet is rebuilt from JING-ZHANG WORKS' own four operating states, complete paper task, seven shift checkpoints, six quote cards, and stop rules. It does not reuse a peer name, text, field combination, schema, graphic, asset, procurement band, or staffing formula.
claim_boundary_zh: 闸盒已经写到可打印和签字的深度，但当前七张回执均未签。它不证明场地授权、专业验收、人员到岗、三家报价、采购许可、公共开放、故障演练或现场效果。
claim_boundary_en: The wallet is specified to printable and signable depth, but none of its seven receipts is signed. It proves no site authorization, professional acceptance, staff attendance, three-quote comparison, purchase permission, public opening, fault drill, or field performance.
